import hashlib, os, pathlib, shutil, stat, subprocess, tempfile
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
def snapshot():
    result = {}
    for folder, dirs, files in os.walk(root):
        for name in dirs + files:
            p = pathlib.Path(folder) / name
            s = p.lstat()
            result[str(p.relative_to(root))] = (stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode), 'link', os.readlink(p)) if p.is_symlink() else (stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode), 'dir' if p.is_dir() else 'file', None if p.is_dir() else p.read_bytes())
    return result
before = snapshot()
source = (root / 'text_edits.py').read_text()
test_bytes = (root / 'test_edits.py').read_bytes()
variants = {
    'correct': source,
    'forward': source.replace('in reversed(ordered):', 'in ordered:'),
    'no_overlap': source.replace('        if start < previous_end:\n            raise ValueError("overlapping edits")\n', ''),
    'in_place': source.replace('    ordered = sorted(edits, key=lambda item: item[0])', '    edits.sort(key=lambda item: item[0])\n    ordered = edits'),
}
instrumentation = '''import hashlib, os, pathlib, sys
root = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent.resolve()
print("AUDIT instrumentation=" + str(pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve()), flush=True)
def trace(frame, event, arg):
    if frame.f_code.co_name != "apply_edits":
        return trace
    if event == "call":
        impl = sys.modules.get("text_edits")
        tests = sys.modules.get("test_edits")
        bound = getattr(tests, "apply_edits", None)
        module_fn = getattr(impl, "apply_edits", None)
        impl_path = pathlib.Path(impl.__file__).resolve()
        test_path = pathlib.Path(tests.__file__).resolve()
        checks = {
            "implementation_in_copy": impl_path == root / "text_edits.py",
            "tests_in_copy": test_path == root / "test_edits.py",
            "binding_is_module_function": bound is module_fn,
            "executing_bound_code": getattr(bound, "__code__", None) is frame.f_code,
            "code_in_copy": pathlib.Path(frame.f_code.co_filename).resolve() == impl_path,
        }
        print("AUDIT binding=" + repr(checks), flush=True)
        print("AUDIT implementation=" + str(impl_path) + " sha256=" + hashlib.sha256(impl_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), flush=True)
        print("AUDIT tests=" + str(test_path) + " sha256=" + hashlib.sha256(test_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), flush=True)
        print("AUDIT input=" + repr(frame.f_locals), flush=True)
    elif event == "exception":
        print("AUDIT exception=" + type(arg[1]).__name__ + ": " + str(arg[1]), flush=True)
    elif event == "return":
        print("AUDIT return=" + repr(arg) + " caller_edits_after=" + repr(frame.f_locals["edits"]), flush=True)
    return trace
sys.settrace(trace)
'''
owned = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='.audit-', dir=root))
observations = []
try:
    for name, content in variants.items():
        copy = owned / name
        copy.mkdir()
        for filename in ['AGENTS.md', 'CONTRACT.md', 'text_edits.py', 'test_edits.py']:
            shutil.copy2(root / filename, copy / filename)
        (copy / 'text_edits.py').write_text(content)
        (copy / 'sitecustomize.py').write_text(instrumentation)
        assert (copy / 'test_edits.py').read_bytes() == test_bytes
        for method in ['test_multiple_edits', 'test_overlap']:
            selector = 'test_edits.EditTests.' + method
            env = os.environ.copy()
            env['PYTHONPATH'] = str(copy)
            env['PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE'] = '1'
            result = subprocess.run(['python3', '-B', '-m', 'unittest', selector, '-v'], cwd=copy, env=env, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, text=True)
            print('\nVARIANT=' + name + ' COMMAND=python3 -B -m unittest ' + selector + ' -v CWD=' + str(copy), flush=True)
            print(result.stdout, end='', flush=True)
            print('EXIT=' + str(result.returncode), flush=True)
            assert 'AUDIT binding=' in result.stdout and ': False' not in result.stdout
            assert hashlib.sha256(test_bytes).hexdigest() in result.stdout
            assert 'Ran 1 test' in result.stdout
            expected = 1 if name == 'no_overlap' and method == 'test_overlap' else 0
            assert result.returncode == expected, (name, method, result.returncode)
            observations.append((name, method, result.returncode))
finally:
    shutil.rmtree(owned)
    after = snapshot()
    assert before == after, 'Original tree changed'
    print('\nPRESERVATION: original paths, file bytes, and modes unchanged; all owned copies and instrumentation removed.', flush=True)
print('OBSERVATIONS=' + repr(observations))
